name: Code review

tags.rule: Produces wrong behaviour. Must be fixed.
Null, bounds, concurrency, or an error path is unhandled.
Naming, structure, or comments mislead the reader.
Repeats logic from elsewhere. Extract or delete.
Missing coverage, or the assertion does not prove much.

exportNote: Work through these one at a time. Do not merge them. Give the final diff and the line numbers you landed on.
